scripts.title: Spawn Parts
scripts.script:
--// MINI PLATFORM RGB SPAWNER
--// ================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--// ================================
--// BEÁLLÍTÁSOK
--// ================================

local SETTINGS = {

	-- Platform mérete
	PlatformSize = Vector3.new(5, 0.7, 5),

	-- Milyen messze legyen előtted
	PlatformDistance = 4,

	-- Lekerekítés
	CornerSize = 0.35,

	-- RGB sebesség
	RGBSpeed = 0.35,

	-- Gomb mérete
	ButtonWidth = 85,
	ButtonHeight = 38,

	-- Jobb felső sarok
	RightOffset = 15,
	TopOffset = 15,

	-- Felirat
	TextSize = 16,
}

--// ================================
--// GUI
--// ================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PlatformSpawner"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(
	0,
	SETTINGS.ButtonWidth,
	0,
	SETTINGS.ButtonHeight
)

frame.Position = UDim2.new(
	1,
	-SETTINGS.ButtonWidth - SETTINGS.RightOffset,
	0,
	SETTINGS.TopOffset
)

frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
frameCorner.Parent = frame

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness = 3
stroke.Parent = frame

--// ================================
--// SPAWN GOMB
--// ================================

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)

button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
button.BorderSizePixel = 0

button.Text = "SPAWN"
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.TextSize = SETTINGS.TextSize
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

button.Parent = frame

local buttonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
buttonCorner.Parent = button

--// ================================
--// RGB FÜGGVÉNY
--// ================================

local function startRGB(object)

	task.spawn(function()

		local hue = 0

		while object.Parent do

			hue += 0.01

			if hue >= 1 then
				hue = 0
			end

			object.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)

			task.wait(SETTINGS.RGBSpeed / 10)

		end

	end)

end

-- RGB a gomb körül
startRGB(stroke)

--// ================================
--// PLATFORM LÉTREHOZÁSA
--// ================================

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	-- A karakter HASA ELŐTT
	local position =
		root.Position
		+ root.CFrame.LookVector * SETTINGS.PlatformDistance

	-- Fő platform
	local platform = Instance.new("Part")

	platform.Name = "MiniRGBPlatform"

	platform.Size = SETTINGS.PlatformSize
	platform.Position = position

	platform.Anchored = true
	platform.CanCollide = true

	platform.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	platform.Parent = workspace

	-- Valódi lekerekítés
	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

	-- A platform alapformája maradjon lapos
	mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

	-- RGB
	startRGB(platform)

end)

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- ================= GUI KORUMASI VE TEMİZLİĞİ =================
local CoreGui
local success, result = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if success and result then 
    CoreGui = result 
else 
    CoreGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") 
end

-- Eski UI varsa ekrandan temizle
for _, v in pairs(CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name == "BestoUI" then 
        v:Destroy() 
    end
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "BestoUI"
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

-- ================= YENİ VE YÜKSEK SESLİ SES EFEKTLERİ =================
local Sounds = { 
    Hover = 4743208535,    -- Tok ve temiz bir Pop sesi
    ClickOn = 4743208535, 
    ClickOff = 4743208535, 
    Intro = 4808968114,    -- Şık ve yüksek sesli sistem başlatma sesi
    Success = 3146430391   -- Tatlı bir başarı (Çın) sesi
}

local function PlaySound(id, volume, pitch)
    task.spawn(function()
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
        sound.Volume = volume or 2.5 -- Ses seviyesi oldukça yükseltildi
        sound.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
        sound.Parent = SoundService
        sound:Play()
        Debris:AddItem(sound, 3)
    end)
end

-- ================= UZUN VE GELİŞMİŞ GİRİŞ ANİMASYONU =================
task.wait(0.5)
local IntroFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
IntroFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
IntroFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
IntroFrame.ZIndex = 999
IntroFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local IntroText = Instance.new("TextLabel", IntroFrame)
IntroText.Text = "Besto"
IntroText.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne -- Daha şık, kalın ve modern bir font
IntroText.TextSize = 85 -- Boyut büyütüldü
IntroText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)
IntroText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
IntroText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.42, 0)
IntroText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
IntroText.ZIndex = 1000
IntroText.TextTransparency = 1

-- Yazıya Derinlik/Gölge Efekti
local ShadowText = Instance.new("TextLabel", IntroText)
ShadowText.Text = "Besto"
ShadowText.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
ShadowText.TextSize = 85
ShadowText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
ShadowText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
ShadowText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0.5, 4)
ShadowText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ShadowText.ZIndex = 999
ShadowText.TextTransparency = 1

local LoadText = Instance.new("TextLabel", IntroFrame)
LoadText.Text = "Sistem yukleniyor"
LoadText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
LoadText.TextSize = 22
LoadText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
LoadText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
LoadText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.58, 0)
LoadText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadText.ZIndex = 1000
LoadText.TextTransparency = 1

PlaySound(Sounds.Intro, 3, 1) -- En yüksek sesle intro başlat
local TweenIn = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
TweenService:Create(IntroFrame, TweenIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
TweenService:Create(IntroText, TweenIn, {TextTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.48, 0)}):Play()
TweenService:Create(ShadowText, TweenIn, {TextTransparency = 0.5}):Play()
TweenService:Create(LoadText, TweenIn, {TextTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.58, 0)}):Play()

local dots = 0
local introActive = true
task.spawn(function()
    while introActive do 
        dots = (dots + 1) % 4
        LoadText.Text = "Sistem yukleniyor" .. string.rep(".", dots)
        task.wait(0.5) 
    end
end)

task.wait(3.5) -- Intro süresi uzatıldı (Daha uzun izlenmesi için)
introActive = false
LoadText.Text = "Basariyla Yuklendi!"
LoadText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
PlaySound(Sounds.Success, 2.5, 1)
task.wait(1.5) -- Başarıyla yüklendi yazısı ekranda daha uzun kalıyor

local TweenOut = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
TweenService:Create(IntroFrame, TweenOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
TweenService:Create(IntroText, TweenOut, {TextTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.42, 0)}):Play()
TweenService:Create(ShadowText, TweenOut, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
TweenService:Create(LoadText, TweenOut, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
task.wait(0.8)

-- ================= ANA PANEL SİSTEMİ =================
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", ScreenGui)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, -50)
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 42)
ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
ToggleBtn.Text = "Besto"

TweenService:Create(ToggleBtn, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 15)}):Play()

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -240)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
MainFrame.Visible = false
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.ZIndex = 90
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame)
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MainFrame)
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)

-- ================= SEKME SİSTEMİ =================
local TabContainer = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
TabContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
TabContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
TabContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local TabListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", TabContainer)
TabListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
TabListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
TabListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

local PageContainer = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
PageContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
PageContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
PageContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local firstTab = true

local function CreateTab(name)
    local TabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", TabContainer)
    TabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0)
    TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
    TabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    TabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TabBtn.TextSize = 13
    TabBtn.Text = name
    
    local TabCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", TabBtn)
    TabCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local TabStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", TabBtn)
    TabStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)
    TabStroke.Transparency = 0.5
    
    local ScrollPage = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", PageContainer)
    ScrollPage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    ScrollPage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ScrollPage.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ScrollPage.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    ScrollPage.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)
    ScrollPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ScrollPage.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    ScrollPage.Visible = firstTab
    
    local PageLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", ScrollPage)
    PageLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    PageLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    PageLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    
    if firstTab then
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)
        TabStroke.Transparency = 0
        firstTab = false
    end
    
    TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PlaySound(Sounds.ClickOn, 2, 1)
        for _, page in pairs(PageContainer:GetChildren()) do
            if page:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then page.Visible = false end
        end
        for _, btn in pairs(TabContainer:GetChildren()) do
            if btn:IsA("TextButton") then 
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30) 
                local stroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if stroke then stroke.Transparency = 0.5 end
            end
        end
        ScrollPage.Visible = true
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)
        TabStroke.Transparency = 0
    end)
    
    return ScrollPage
end

-- ================= BUTON OLUŞTURMA FONKSİYONU =================
local function CreateButton(parentTab, text, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parentTab)
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 38)
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    Btn.TextSize = 14
    Btn.Text = text
    
    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", Btn)
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Btn)
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)
    Stroke.Thickness = 1
    Stroke.Transparency = 0.4
    
    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PlaySound(Sounds.ClickOn, 2, 1)
        pcall(callback) 
    end)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local running = true

local connection
connection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
		running = false
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local winPart = workspace:WaitForChild("WinPart")
	
	while running do
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		
		if hrp and winPart then
			hrp.CFrame = winPart.CFrame
			
			local prompt = winPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
			if prompt then
				fireproximityprompt(prompt)
			end
		end
		
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)
